name: Volatile Magma Core
primary:
A magma core that bursts into shards and leaves a hot patch.
A projectile flies in an arc where you look and explodes in a 3.5-block radius on hit. The explosion comes 0.6 s after impact. 4 shards scatter around with the same effects on creatures they touch. Effects:
• Damage 1 ❤ fire + 1 ❤ earth + 1 ❤ arcane (fire ×0.5 on wet, earth ×2 on frozen)
• Heat: sets on fire for 6 s (wet targets just dry off), thaws; melts ice and burns roots
• Light push
• Breaks up to 3 blocks within 0.5 blocks (twice as many if brittle)
• Arcane instability: −0.25 ❤ every 2 s for 4.95 s
• Leaves a 2-block zone for 5 s that repeats these effects every second
self_description:
On you:
• Damage 1 ❤ fire (fire ×0.5 on wet)
• Heat: sets on fire for 6 s (wet targets just dry off), thaws; melts ice and burns roots
• Stone skin (Resistance I) for 7.7 s
• Slowness I for 6.05 s
• Arcane instability: −0.25 ❤ every 2 s for 4.95 s
